options: Turns source code into something that can run
check.explanation: Building compiles, bundles and packages your code into a form that can be run or shipped.
check.hint: It prepares the code to run.

options: Builds and tests every change automatically
check.explanation: CI checks every change as it arrives, so problems are found while they are small.

options: It is repeatable and less likely to go wrong than manual steps
check.explanation: A pipeline does the same steps every time, which removes a lot of human error.
check.hint: Humans forget steps, and scripts do not.
